purpose: Correct the Phase 5BW source-overlap audit by deriving source identity only from the task prompt and its declared provenance URL. This protocol freezes a public-source candidate roster before any FALSUM candidate inference. It does not establish private-pool disjointness or a blind holdout.

upstream_phase5bw.role: Authenticate the immutable external corpus, author metadata, row identities, published raw-score arithmetic, and the previously frozen public FALSUM source inventory.

external.row_identity_algorithm: SHA256(UTF8(NFC-and-whitespace-normalized prompt + NUL + chosen + NUL + rejected))

selection_policy.reason: Candidate answer text can contain incorrect advisory identifiers. Using an identifier that appears only in an answer as source provenance can falsely classify a pair as source-disjoint. Row 23 demonstrates this failure.
selection_policy.overlap_rule: A pair overlaps if any CVE/GHSA identifier extracted from prompt or provenance.source_url appears in the frozen public FALSUM inventory.
selection_policy.candidate_rule: A pair is a public-source-disjoint candidate only when at least one CVE/GHSA identifier appears in prompt or provenance.source_url and none overlaps the frozen public inventory.
selection_policy.unclassified_rule: Pairs with no CVE/GHSA identifier in prompt or provenance.source_url remain unclassified, even if an identifier appears in chosen or rejected answer text.
selection_policy.row_identity_rule: Continue to use the upstream row identity algorithm over prompt, chosen, and rejected for one-to-one corpus/metadata binding. This identity hash is not used as source provenance.
selection_policy.answer_only_identifiers: May be reported as a diagnostic but must never alter source classification.
selection_policy.reason_heldout_ineligible: The private contents of FALSUM's historical Anjoman evaluation material are not publicly accessible for exact source-identity comparison.

limits: The 40 pairs are AI-assisted and author-reviewed by two external authors; none is fully human-written.
The external project's 31/40 adapter result is published arithmetic, not a reproduced model inference.
The reported 60% strongest shortcut baseline is an external report claim; raw shortcut predictions were not independently replayed.
The 8 public-source-disjoint candidates are not a blind or eligible heldout set because private FALSUM pool overlap is UNKNOWN.
The 8 candidates contain 6 distinct GHSA identifiers and are not 8 independent advisory families.
No FALSUM model score, false-acceptance rate, false-rejection rate, coverage, abstention, or improvement is measured by this source-identity protocol.
No Telegraph material acceptance, active pool use, ranking change, third-party adoption, or official score is implied.
